review.report: AK-puzzle-pictures R1/V1, pack-192. Derived from the generated square by flattening the outer 5% frame to the median of the outer 1% ring (RGB [197, 202, 207]), then BOX downsampling to 20x20, one colour per board cell, alpha composited over white; re-running the derive reproduces the committed pixel with zero differing cells (S1, S5, S6, K1, K6). Filled 131/400 by the fixed rule (alpha over white, Y = 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B on 0-255 sRGB, Y < 128), inside the 100-180 band; one line-logic solution reaching this fill set (S2-S4, K2, K3). Pixel look: the silhouette still reads at 20x20 as a wide slab with one large square window cut through its right half and a separate small block below it (two masses of 121 and 10 cells, one enclosed 20-cell window), which is what the square shows (AES.P1, K4). No per-puzzle subject class is assigned or recorded. No series (SS1 none). License: Cheaper Inference terms.
